journeys.title_zh: 普罗旺斯：花园、香气与蒸馏
journeys.hook_zh: 从玫瑰、薰衣草与香草园开始，看植物如何进入蒸馏器、药房、香水产业与今天的芳香文化。
journeys.hook_en: Start with roses, lavender and aromatic gardens, then follow plants into stills, apothecaries, perfumery and modern aroma culture.

journeys.title_zh: 广西瑶浴：一桶热水里的植物世界
journeys.title_en: Yao Medicinal Bathing: A Botanical World in Hot Water
journeys.hook_zh: 先看一眼“瑶浴到底是什么”，再展开植物、家庭实践、民族医药语境、安全与现代研究。
journeys.hook_en: First understand what Yao medicinal bathing is, then unfold plants, household practice, ethnomedical context, safety and modern research.

journeys.title_zh: 印度：从日常起居走进 Ayurveda
journeys.title_en: India: Entering Ayurveda Through Everyday Life
journeys.hook_zh: 不先背 Dosha。先看人们怎样安排饮食、油浴、植物、呼吸和一天的节奏。
journeys.hook_en: No need to memorize doshas first. See how food, oil massage, plants, breath and daily rhythm fit together.

journeys.title_zh: 世界声音疗愈：同一个词下的不同世界
journeys.title_en: Sound & Healing: Different Worlds Under One Label
journeys.hook_zh: 吟唱、音乐治疗、鼓、颂钵、振动声学和“频率疗愈”并不是同一件事。这里把它们一层层拆开。
journeys.hook_en: Chant, music therapy, drums, singing bowls, vibroacoustics and ‘frequency healing’ are not the same thing. Explore them layer by layer.

plants.story_zh: 一朵花如何连接农田、蒸馏、香水、药房和现代芳香文化。
plants.story_en: How one flower connects fields, distillation, perfumery, pharmacy and modern aroma culture.

plants.region_zh: 西亚 / 欧洲 / 全球
plants.story_zh: 既是花园植物，也是香材、纯露与文化象征。
plants.story_en: A garden flower, aromatic material, hydrosol source and cultural symbol.

plants.story_zh: 从端午草束到艾灸与药浴，看同一植物怎样进入不同生活场景。
plants.story_en: From seasonal herb bundles to moxibustion and bathing, see one plant across many contexts.

plants.story_zh: 植物、山林、贸易、珍贵药材与现代商品化交织在一起。
plants.story_en: A story of forests, trade, precious materia medica and modern commercialization.

plants.region_zh: 阿拉伯半岛 / 非洲之角
plants.story_zh: 树脂如何沿贸易路线进入宗教、香气、药房与仪式。
plants.story_en: How a resin travelled through trade into religion, scent, pharmacy and ritual.

plants.story_zh: 厨房、染色、传统医药与现代研究围绕同一种根茎展开。
plants.story_en: Kitchen, dye, traditional medicine and modern research meet around one rhizome.

storyHighlights.zh: 当河流、植物与圣所组成疗愈空间
storyHighlights.en: When rivers, plants and sanctuaries formed healing spaces

storyHighlights.zh: 一本药物书如何跨越地中海
storyHighlights.en: How a materia medica text crossed the Mediterranean

storyHighlights.zh: 翻译、药房与蒸馏如何重新连接世界
storyHighlights.en: How translation, pharmacy and distillation reconnected worlds

storyHighlights.zh: 植物园、香料与远洋贸易改变了什么
storyHighlights.en: What botanical gardens, aromatics and long-distance trade changed

storyHighlights.zh: 温泉、芳香与近代健康旅行兴起
storyHighlights.en: The rise of spas, aromatics and modern health travel

storyHighlights.zh: 传统疗愈进入证据、安全与文化权利时代
storyHighlights.en: Traditional healing enters an era of evidence, safety and cultural rights
